description: Integration glue module that wires the four recently-built enrichment modules (community_signal_enrichment, tool_description_safety_enrichment, permission_scope_enrichment, temporal_stability_enrichment) into signal_analyser_v2. Must call each module's compute_score() with registry metadata and write results to mcp_signal_enrichments via write_service POST :8772/write. Signal contract: evidence_blob must contain {signal_type, confidence, evidence_blob}. The signal quality diagnostic shows only 4 distinct values for three signals despite enrichment modules existing—this wiring is the likely gap. Daemon pattern with heartbeat to service_health every 60s.
